name: The Day of the Jackal
description: An unrivalled and highly elusive lone assassin, the Jackal, makes his living carrying out hits for the highest fee. But following his latest kill, he meets his match in a tenacious British intelligence officer who starts to track down the Jackal in a thrilling cat-and-mouse chase across Europe, leaving destruction in its wake.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: When an elite assassin carries out a kill, it catches the attention of an intelligence officer, who starts to hunt him down.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: With his client backing out of payment, the Jackal's reputation is on the line, and he starts to plot his revenge.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Armed with the knowledge of his wayward client's identity, the Jackal tracks him down in Munich, determined to settle the score.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: His vengeance fulfilled, the Jackal flees Munich and tries to quell Nuria's suspicions. Bianca follows a new lead in her hunt.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: The Jackal visits Norman with a special commission... but with Bianca also tracking Norman down, she is starting to close in on him.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Following his shootout with Bianca, the Jackal must escape his captors and regroup ahead of his next hit, as Bianca follows his trail.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: The Jackal and Bianca head to Tallinn before UDC's announcement. The Jackal must use all his wiles as he prepares to take his shot.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Bianca gains insight into a secret file. She learns the true identity of the Jackal and how he became a contract killer.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: With the release of River imminent, UDC believes himself safe. As time runs out, the Jackal must use all his skills to reach his target.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: A wanted man, the Jackal is on the run, desperate to get back to Nuria, but Bianca is given one last shot to bring him to justice.

awards: Nominated for 1 Primetime Emmy. 24 nominations total
